desc: Makes household small appliances, mainly vacuum cleaners and robot vacuums, largely as an OEM supplier to overseas brands.

desc: Thai electronics manufacturer producing printers, scanners and other office and consumer electronics for global brand customers on contract.

desc: Hong Kong-listed maker of camera modules and optical components for smartphones, supplying major handset brands from factories in mainland China.

desc: Produces electric shavers, hair clippers and other personal-care small appliances, largely as OEM supplier to global brands.

desc: Designs and manufactures smart-home and consumer electronic products, including small appliances, for international brand customers on ODM basis.

desc: Produces smart electronics and home appliances as ODM, including smart speakers, audio and smart-home devices, for global brands.

desc: Sells residential and commercial lighting products, smart lighting and related controls under the Opple brand, mostly in China.

rationale: Lighting brand with some overseas ambition; F1 offers limited benefit besides brand awareness and project showcase.

desc: Manufactures set-top boxes, broadband access and home gateway devices for telecom operators and pay-TV providers worldwide.

desc: Foxconn-controlled group providing mobile handset assembly and components, including casings and modules, for major global phone brands.
